reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; the cited paragraphs substantively support that classification.

§24.1 grants Customer a consent-free affiliate/successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, sale of substantially all assets) carve-out with notice only, matching the preferred position, and §13.3 extends the carve-out to licence rights.

§24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance and change-of-control transfer to Customer's prior written consent (reasonableness-qualified) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor; §24.3's mutual consent standard is symmetrical.
§24.4 expressly negates any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control, so no walk-away trigger exists.

Deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out; the only shortfall from literal preferred wording (competitor bar is subject to Customer consent rather than absolute) is a minor sub-element correctly noted rather than redlined, and the clause is favourable to us.
